assumptions.statement: The two workbooks are target-aware research overlays, not canonical QP093A row authority.
A saved Excel SaveCopyAs capture is logically equivalent to the open saved first workbook only if cell reconciliation passes.
The 81 membership may be used to infer candidate rules during discovery but cannot validate them.
QP p8+p1=p9 is an arithmetic shadow of the typed S8+X1->W9 relation only if source roles privilege it over p6+p3.
Typed witness and reveal exclusions can close accounting debt even when the existing CR274 model contains no repeated QP constituent fee to remove.
